name: Peggy — Stories into Blog Rows (Celebrity QDE posts)

parameters.formDescription: Upload the RICK story list as a .md file (numbered, ALL-CAPS title first, then the pitch). Each story is fact-checked on the web and, if it passes, written as a complete new row in QDE_Post_Queue with status blank. Duplicates and stories with no documented handwriting/document examination are rejected. Results post to Slack #qde-celebrity-post-review. Nothing is published.

values.formSubmittedText: Got it. Each story takes about a minute or two to research and write. The rows land in QDE_Post_Queue (status blank) and a summary posts to Slack #qde-celebrity-post-review when the batch is done.
